children.q: How do I transcribe a voice recording?
children.a: Download Meetily, open your audio file or start a new recording, and get instant AI transcription. It works with any audio format - MP3, WAV, M4A, and more. All processing happens locally on your device for complete privacy.

Meetily Community Edition is free for personal use with no time limits or restrictions. It's open source (MIT license). For teams needing advanced features like PDF/DOCX export and speaker identification, Pro plans start at $10/user/month.

children.q: Can I transcribe recordings from my phone?
children.a: Yes! Transfer your phone recordings to your computer and transcribe them with Meetily. We support all common audio formats from iPhone (M4A) and Android (MP3, OGG) devices.

children.q: How accurate is the voice to text transcription?
children.a: Meetily offers dual transcription engines: Whisper for maximum accuracy or Parakeet for optimal speed. Accuracy varies by audio quality, background noise, and accents. Both deliver competitive, state-of-the-art results.

children.q: Does my voice recording get sent to the cloud?
children.a: No. All transcription happens 100% locally on your device. Your voice recordings never leave your computer. This makes Meetily perfect for confidential or sensitive recordings.

children.q: What's the difference between Meetily and online transcription services?
children.a: Online services upload your audio to their servers, creating privacy risks. Meetily processes everything locally - your recordings stay private. The Community Edition is free for personal use, while Pro offers advanced features for individuals and teams.
